canary_scope: Four training/discovery base shapes only; 1/36 layers per segment, unchanged and eviction sequences, both memory ceilings. No fresh-test outcome used.
mixed_canary_results_retained: 128MiB often collapses arms to identical feasible plans. At512MiB, one4090 training case has about1.11x fixed/native_cycle ratio at36 layers, and one5090 training case about1.10x unchanged/about1.08x eviction. Other cases tie or regress. Those are not heldout results and not universal gains.
full_test_plan: Unchanged measurement source and frozen model weights. Three process/seed repeats per GPU; bounded parallel array. Primary endpoint36-layer native_cycle versus TRAIN-budget fixed with equal plan and cache reuse. Check stock auto separately; report all regressions. No official autotuner result is claimed for this unregistered0.6.18 FA2 surface.
baseline_selection_caveat: Budget/head/reuse fixed options are selected from TRAIN-only prior policy measurements using cycle+(r-1)*CUDA-run as a training proxy. This proxy is not reported as direct reuse performance; every arm is scored on fresh direct wall-clock episodes.
boundary: Attention-stack replay has36 distinct layer tensors but no model weights/MLPs/network/scheduler; it is NOT full-model serving. Four identical-geometry segments permit144 attention calls per plan at36 layers, while changed-geometry sequences require replanning per segment. All arms get identical opportunities.
safety: Current two submissions succeeded through the normal Remote Desktop Commander terminal action; no alternate launcher or approval setting was used. Existing unrelated jobs were left unchanged. This does not erase prior safety refusals.
